abilities.name: Combat Prowess
abilities.description: You add +1 damage to one type of weapon attack of your choice: melee weapon attacks or ranged weapon attacks.

abilities.name: Despite My Wounds
abilities.description: While you have two or more moderate wounds or one major wound, you get a free reroll on one action each round (as if you had spent 1 XP). Enabler.

abilities.name: Expert Combatant
abilities.description: You are trained in a specific weapon attack of your choice, such as swords, axes, or bows; or in a broader category of attacks such as light bashing weapons, light bladed weapons, light ranged weapons, medium bashing weapons, medium bladed weapons, medium ranged weapons, and so on.
